GitHub Actions Workflow Generator

Generate a CI workflow YAML — language presets, triggers, build and test steps.

📖 How to use

  1. Name the workflow and pick a language preset.
  2. Choose triggers (push, pull request) and branches.
  3. Toggle tests and add extra run steps.
  4. Copy the YAML or download ci.yml.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which languages are supported?

Node.js, Python, Go, Java (Maven), .NET and Rust — each with idiomatic setup, build and test steps.

How are extra steps formatted?

One per line as "Step name: shell command".

Where does the file go?

Save it as .github/workflows/ci.yml in your repository.

Is the YAML valid?

Yes — standard workflow syntax using current action versions (checkout@v4, setup-*/v4/v5).
